definitions.explanation: Something one aims to achieve; an end toward which effort is directed.

examples.japanese: {目標|もくひょう}を{決|き}める。
{高|たか}い{目標|もくひょう}を{持|も}つことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to have high goals.

examples.japanese: {目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}するために{努力|どりょく}する。
examples.english: To work hard to achieve a goal.
examples.notes: 目標を達成する = to achieve a goal

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{今年度|こんねんど}の{売上|うりあげ}{目標|もくひょう}を{大|おお}きく{上回|うわまわ}った。
examples.english: The company greatly exceeded its sales target for this fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{目標|もくひょう}に{向|む}かって{毎日|まいにち}{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けた{結果|けっか}、{念願|ねんがん}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}ることができた。
examples.english: As a result of working hard toward her goal every day, she was able to obtain the qualification she had long wished for.

notes:
USAGE: {目標|もくひょう} is used for concrete goals or targets. It's more specific than {目的|もくてき} (purpose).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{目標|もくひょう}を{立|た}てる (to set a goal)
・{目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}する (to achieve a goal)
・{目標|もくひょう}に{向|む}かう (to work toward a goal)

CONTRAST:
・{目標|もくひょう} - specific, measurable target
・{目的|もくてき} - broader purpose or aim
